DOP: 1 gandha m. (and n. ) [ ts ], 1. a smell, odour; a scent ; Abh 94; 1129 (~o … ghāyanīye); Vin I 21, 19* (rūpā saddā ~ā rasā phoṭṭhabbā ca); 205, 9 (yasmiṃ telapāke majjassa na vaṇṇo na ~o na raso paññāyati); D I 182, 2 (ghānena ~aṃ ghāyitvā); M I 112, 5 (ghānaṃ c’ āvuso paṭicca ~e ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ); S I 115, 30 (tav’ eva pāpima ghānaṃ tava ~ā); 226, 29* (~o isīnam asuci); A I 226, 29* (na pupphagandho paṭivātam eti … sataṃ ca ~o paṭivātam eti, sabbā disā sappuriso pavāti) = Dhp 54; Th 28 (kacci sīlamayaṃ ~aṃ tvaṃ vāsi); Ja III 289, 11* (gaṇhāhi navaṃ vilepanaṃ yassa ~o na kadāci chijjati); Ap 268, 22 (candanasseva me kāyā tathā ~o pavāyati); 347, 20 (tāni ~āni ghāyanto); Paṭis I 145, 7 (idaṃ pupphaṃ ayaṃ ~o); Kv 67, 10 (ghānaṃ suññaṃ ~ā suññā) = Nidd I 439, 26 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~aṃ suññaṃ); Mil 80, 12 (ghāyitattā ~aṃ sarati); Vism 447, 1 (ghānapaṭihanana-lakkhaṇo ~o); Ps II 360, 22 (pupphasmiṃ ~aṃ viya attani rūpaṃ samanupassati); Pj I 72, 10 (aggipakkhittassa kesassa ~aṃ ghāyitvā sattā nāsikaṃ pidhenti); — ifc see āma- ( sv āma 2 ), panna- ( sv pajjati 1 ); — 2. a fragrant substance; scent, perfume; (iic fragrant, scented) ; Vin III 38, 38 (itthiyo ~aṃ ca mālaṃ ca ādāya ārāmaṃ āgamaṃsu); D II 159, 21 (bhagavato sarīraṃ … mālehi ~ehi sakkarontā); A I 215, 3* (mālaṃ na dhāre na ca ~am ācare) = Sn 401; Ja I 50, 15 (~ehi vilimpāpetvā); 452, 16 (~e piṃsituṃ … na jānantī ti); IV 76, 25* (dadāti saddho mālaṃ ca ~aṃ ca vilepanaṃ ca); Nidd I 114, 24 (bāhaṃ ~ena limpeyyuṃ); Mil 309, 21 (~aṃ vā mālaṃ vā dussaṃ vā … adhiṭṭhahitvā cetiye ukkhipati); Sp 84, 18 (pattaṃ gahetvā ~ehi ubbaṭṭetvā); — ifc see anulepana-; — 3. the mere smell of anything, a whiff, a small quantity ; Abh 1129 (~o thoke); Nidd-a I 37, 5 (niravasesaṃ °-mattaṃ pi aṭṭhapetvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee khandha-mattaṃ); — 4. the name of a type of elephants ; Abh 361 (… piṅgalo ~o); Ps II 25, 36* (°-maṅgalahemaṃ); — see gandhahatthi(n) below ; — gandha is an occasional wr (or alternative form?) for gantha qv ; — gandhaṃ in Ee at Spk III 70, 29 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se vātaṃ; — gandhā in Ee at Ap 3, 26 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se gantvā; — °’- āyatana , n. , the object of sense that is odour ; D III 243, 18 (cha bāhirāni āyatanāni … ~aṃ rasāyatanaṃ …); Dhs 625–8 (katamaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ~aṃ); Vism 452, 6 ; — °’- ālepa , m. , a fragrant or perfumed ointment ; Vin I 206, 26 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ kātun ti); Ap 516, 7 ; — ° ôdaka , n. [gandha + udaka], fragrant or perfumed water ; Ja III 178, 22 (tam enaṃ … mātā ~ena nahāpetvā alaṅkaritvā kīḷāpayamānā nisinnā); Ap 105, 22 ; Ps III 214, 24 (suvaṇṇaghaṭe ca rajataghaṭe ca ~assa pūretvā); Th-a I 131, 7 (bodhirukkhaṃ ~ehi nahāpesi); Thūp 241, 20 ; — °’ ûpahāra , m. , the bringing of a foul-smelling or fragrant substance ; Vin III 74, 31 ; 77, 23 (~o nāma amanāpikaṃ gandhaṃ upasaṃharati … imaṃ ghāyitvā jegucchatā pāṭikulyatā marissatī ti … manāpikaṃ gandhaṃ upasaṃharati …); — °’- ūhana , °-ūhana, °ôhana, n. , considering a fragrant substance; smelling ;? A IV 395, 29 (yo ca antamaso gandhohana-mattaṃ pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya, Be so; Ce gandhuhana-; Ee, Se gaddūhana-; Mp IV 187, 1 : ~-mattan ti gandha-ūhanamattaṃ, dvīh’ aṅgulīhi gandhapiṇḍaṃ gahetvā upasiṅghanamattaṃ, apare pana gadduhana-mattan ti pāḷiṃ vatvā …, Ee so; Ce apare pana gaddūhanamattan ti …; Se apare pana godohanamattan ti …; Be gandhohanamattan ti … apare pana gaddohana-mattan ti …); Spk II 224, 12 (gaddūhanamattan ti godūhanamattaṃ …°-mattaṃ vā dvīhi aṅgulīhi gaṇḍa-piṇḍaṃ gahetvā ekavāraṃ ghāyanamattan ti attho, Ce so; Ee gandūhanamattaṃ vā …; Se gandha-ūhanamattaṃ vā …; Be gadduhanamattan ti goduhanamattaṃ … gandha-ūhanamattaṃ vā …); — see also gaddūhana; — °- kaṭṭha , n. [gandha + kaṭṭha 2 ], a fragrant or sweet-smelling piece of wood ; Spk II 380, 3 (bahūni ~āni samodhānetvā); Ps V 63, 20 ; — °- kuṭī̆ , f. , the fragrant or perfumed hut (the name of the Buddha’s cabin, especially that in the Jetavana; see J.S. Strong, 1977 ); Abh 211; Ja I 92, 23 (Jetavanaṃ … kiṇitvā … majjhe dasabalassa ~iṃ kāresi); Ap 186, 3 ; Sp 651, 7 (bhagavati divāpaṭisallānatthāya ~iṃ paviṭṭhe); Dhp-a II 135, 4 (satthā … ~iyam eva nisinno); Ud-a 184, 11 (haṃsa-vaṭṭakachannena katā sabbākārasampannā buddhassa bhagavato ~ī kuṭāgārasālā nāma); Mhv 4:32; — °- kuṭikā , f. , id. , Sv 407, 21 (~āya ca sālāya ca antare); — °- gandha , m. , 1. the scent of perfume(s) ; Sp 750, 12 (agarukuṅkumādīnaṃ gandhānaṃ gandho ~o); — 2. perfume from fragrant plants ;? a totally fragrant plant ;? S III 250, 12 (santi bhikkhave mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā … pattagandhe … pupphagandhe … phalagandhe … rasagandhe … ~e; Spk II 350, 21 : mūlagandhe adhivatthā ti yassa rukkhassa mūle gandho atthi taṃ nissāya nibbattā … ~e ti mūlādigandhānaṃ gandhe, yassa hi rukkhassa sabbesaṃ pi mūlādīnaṃ gandho attthi so idha gandho nāma tassa gandhassa gandhe tasmiṃ adhivatthā); Ps III 35, 19 (Gandha-mādanakūṭaṃ … pupphagandho phalagandho ~o ti imehi dasahi gandhehi ussannaṃ) = Mp IV 108, 13 ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce khandhagandho ti) = Ud-a 300, 25 ; — °- gandhi(n) , mfn. , fragrant with scent ; Vin IV 18, 14 (sā itthi … alaṅkatapaṭiyattā ~inī; Sp 750, 12 : agaru-kuṅkumādīnaṃ gandhānaṃ gandho gandhagandho, so assa atthī ti ~inī); Ap 432, 19 (parisā tassa ~ī bhavissati); — °- gandhita , mfn. , fragrant with scent ; Ap 180, 4 (pupphaṃ ocinitvāna sugandhaṃ ~aṃ, Ee so, perhaps wr; Se °-gandhikaṃ; Be, Ce gandhitaṃ subhaṃ); — °- ghāyana , n. , smelling an odour ; Spk I 151, 28 (gūtha-dassane pana tesaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tassa ~e ghāna-viññāṇaṃ); — °- cuṇṇa , n. , fragrant powder; powdered scent ; Ja III 277, 7 (tassa vilimpantassa pādamūle ~aṃ patissati); Vism 346, 30 ; Spk I 262, 22 (sarīraṃ telena abbhañjitvā ubbaṭṭetvā ~’-ādīhi nahāpesuṃ); II 185, 27 (pattaṃ dhovitvā ~ena ubbaṭṭetvā); Th-a I 171, 18 (gandhodakena ~ena ca pūjaṃ akāsi); — °- cuṇṇaka , n. , fragrant powder ; Sp 1312, 31 (~ena nhāyeyya); — °- thena , m. , a scent-thief, one who steals the fragrance of something ; S I 204, 30* (yam etaṃ vārijaṃ pupphaṃ adinnaṃ upasiṅghasi … ~o si) = Ja III 308, 17* ; — °- dharo in Ee at Sv 127, 3 is wr for ganthadharo ( Be, Ce so; Se ganthadhuro); — °- dhātu , f. , the constituent element that is odour ; M III 62, 12 (aṭṭhārasa … dhātuyo … ghānadhātu ~u ghānaviññaṇadhātu …); Dhs 625; Vibh 413, 35 ; Vism 484, 29 ; Spk II 131, 12 (gandhārammaṇaṃ ~u); — °- pañcaṅgula , n. , a mark made by the spread hand (which has been dipped) in a fragrant substance ; Ja IV 153, 27 (rukkhe ~aṃ datvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se -pañcaṅgulikaṃ); Ap 3, 22 (°-pañcaṅgulaṅkitā, Ee so; Be °-pañcaṅgulakatā; Ce °-pañcaṅgulikatā; Se °-pañcāṅgulaṅkatā; Ap-a 109, 4 : °-pañcaṅgulaṅkitā ti pañcahi aṅgulehi limpitā gandhehi alaṅkatā, Ce so; Ee °-pañcaṅgulalaṅkitā ti; Be, Se °-pañcaṅgulalaṅkatā ti … limpitagandhehi …); Spk I 242, 25 (setamālāhi c’ eva ~ehi ca alaṅkatā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-pañcaṅgulīhi); — °- pañcaṅgulika , n. , a mark made by the spread hand (which has been dipped) in a fragrant substance ; Vv 33:47 (~aṃ ahaṃ adāsiṃ … bhagavato thūpasmiṃ; Vv-a 147, 4 : ~an ti gandhena pañcaṅgulikadānaṃ); Ja II 256, 2 (cetiye ~aṃ dethā ti gandhe adāsi); Ps II 261, 10 ([usabhe] ~ehi maṇḍeti); Dhp-a III 374, 9 (goṇānaṃ ~āni datvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pañcaṅgulikāni); — °- piṃsanaka , m. ( or n. ) a grinder of fragrant substances ; ( None ;) Sv 924, 16 (~-nisadāya, Ce, Se so; Be °-pisanakanisadāya; Ee gandhaṃ piṃsanakanisadāya); — °- va(t) , mfn. , possessing fragrance ; Ps III 222, 10 (vaṇṇavantaṃ °-vantaṃ rasavantaṃ); — °- vāha , m. , one of the winds in the body ; Abh 38; — °- sāra , m. , sandal-wood ; Abh 300 (candano … ~o); — °- hatthi(n) , m. [ cf BHS gandhahastin; cf S. gandhagaja, “elephant in rut” ], a kind of elephant ; Ps II 26, 7 (yaṃ dasannaṃ piṅgalānaṃ [kāyabalaṃ] taṃ ekassa ~ino); Cp-a 50, 5 (~ino ayobandhanaṃ chinditvā vanagamanaṃ viya); — ifc see tathāgata-; — agandha , mfn. , without a scent ; Ja III 253, 24´ (~-tāya gandhena na tappeti, Be, Ee so; Ce agandhitatāya; Se agandhitāya); VI 92, 27´ (na hi tattha ~o nāma rukkho atthi); — duggandha , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) a bad smell, a stink, a stench ; Abh 146; Ja III 455, 24 (kāyato ca mukhato ca sugandhaṃ ~aṃ viya karissati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee gandhaṃ ~aṃ); Dhs 625; Spk III 14, 3* (pañca gaṇhant’ anatthāni … ~aṃ asuciṃ vyādhiṃ …); Th-a I 92, 29 (dussīlattā yeva dussīlamayaṃ ~aṃ vāyati); — ~-kara, mfn. , making a bad smell ; Th 1152 (sarīraṃ … ~-karaṃ karīsaparibandhaṃ, so read with Th App II p. 237, 20* ? Be, Ce ~-karaṃ paribandhaṃ; Ee ~aṃ kariparibandha; Se duggandhakaṃ parivajjeyya); — atiduggandha, m. , a very bad smell ; Cp-a 142, 6 (ati-duggandhavāyanena, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee akitti-duggandhavāyanena); — 2. ( mfn. ) evil-smelling, stinking ; Vin II 148, 27 (vihārā avātapānakā honti … ~ā); A I 34, 27 (appamattako pi gūtho ~o hoti); Sn 205 (dipādako ’yaṃ asuci ~o parihīrati); Pv 6:1 (naggā dubbaṇṇarūpā si ~ā pūti vāyasi); Ja VI 111, 24* (rahado ayaṃ muttakarīsapūro ~-rūpo); Mil 172, 14 (~aṃ pi go-muttaṃ pītaṃ); Vism 108, 15 ; Sp 1193, 27 (~-tāya); Mp IV 121, 19 (pūtimuttam eva vuccati ~-ttā); Dhp-a I 51, 2 (taṃ ṭhānaṃ … ~-taraṃ ca hoti); — atiduggandha, mfn. , extremely evil-smelling ; Pj II 286, 9 ; — niggandha , mfn. , free from scent; odourless ; Ja V 236, 1 ; Dhp-a I 51, 1 ; — sugandha , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) a fragrant or pleasant smell ; Ap 510, 2 (taṃ gharaṃ vāsayiṃsu ~ena); Dhs 625 (~o duggandho); Mp I 234, 24 (sakalanagaraṃ ~-gandhitaṃ hoti, Ce, Ee so; Be ~-gandhikaṃ; Se gandhagandhakaṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) sweet-smelling, fragrant ; D III 199, 34* (~aṃ taṇḍulaphalaṃ); Ja III 277, 8 (~ā bhavissāmi); Ap 397, 18 ; Th-a I 84, 25 (mayhaṃ sarīram eva ~aṃ hotū ti); — atisugandha, mfn. , very sweet-smelling ; Ps III 215,5 (pāsādo atisugandho hoti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se atisugandhagandho); — see also agandhaka, duggandhiya, devagandhika, pūtigandhaka, sagandhaka.
